description: 2D primitive — an open polyline from a list of points (metres). Draws as a stroke; no fill, no 3D.
instructions: A 2D open polyline — a construction / detail line from `points` (a JSON array of [x, y] metre pairs, local to the flow anchor). Drawn as a stroke only (no fill, no 3D), like a `line` rule in a parametric object. Wire `valin-color` to tint it. Used by object decompile to represent a `line` rule (seams, trims, glazing lines).
